_about: Emer de Vattel (1714-1767) in English, raw IA OCR: The Law of Nations, or Principles of the Law of Nature applied to the conduct and affairs of nations and sovereigns, from the new edition by Joseph Chitty, with additional notes and references by Edward D. Ingraham (Philadelphia: T. and J. W. Johnson, 1853; entered 1852). The English translation is the anonymous eighteenth-century one that Chitty revised. US public domain. Added in round ao: the Carnegie translation by Charles G. Fenwick, introduction by Albert de Lapradelle (Washington: Carnegie Institution, 1916), its English volume III only; volumes I-II of that set are a facsimile of the 1758 French text and are not taken. No uids minted.
